Menimbang Mengingat bahwa tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan merupakan
a. pelanggaran hak asasi manusia sehingga perlu dilindungi harga diri dan martabatnya serta dijamin hak hidupnya sesuai dengan kodratnya tanpa diskriminasi;  

bahwa untuk mencegah dan menalggulangi kekerasan
b. terhadap perempuan perlu dilakukan perlindungan hukum terhadap perempu€rn korban kekerasan;  

bahwa di Kabupaten Penajam Paser Utara belum memiliki
c. dasar pengaturan mengenai penyelenggaraan perlindungan perempuan korban kekerasan;  

bahwa berdasarkan pertimbangan sebagaimana dimaksud
d. dalam huruf a, huruf b, dan huruf c, perlu menetapkan Peraturan Daerah tentang Perlindungan Perempuan Korban Kekerasan;

##### MEMUTUSKAN:

Menetapkan PERATURAN DAERAH TEI{TANG PERUNDUNGAN PEREMPUAN KORBAN KEKERASAN.

# BAB I

## KETENTUAN UMUM

#### Pasal 1

Dalam Peraturan Daerah ini yang dimaksud dengan:
l. Daerah adalah Kabupaten Penajam Paser Utara.  
2. Pemerintah Daerah adalah Bupati sebagai unsur penyelenggara pemerintahan Daerah yang memimpin pelaksanaan urusan pemerintahan yang menjadi kewenangan daerah otonom Kabupaten Penajam Paser Utara.  
3. Bupati adalah Bupati Penajam Paser Utara.  
4. Desa adalah kesatuan masyarakat hukum yang memiliki batas wilayah yalg berwenang untuk mengatur dan mengurus urusan pemerinta-han, kepentingal masyarakat setempat berdasarkan prakarsa masyarakat, hak asal usul dan/atau hak tradisional yang diakui dan dihormati dalam sistem pemerintahan Negara Kesatuan Republik Indonesia.  
5. Keluarga adalah orang ya-ng mempunyai hubungan darah dalam garis lurus ke atas atau ke bawah dan garis menyamping sampai derajat ketiga, atau yang mempunyai hubungan perkawinan, atau orzrng yang menjadi tanggungan perempuan.  
6. Pelayanan adalah kegiatan dan tindakan segera yang dilakukan oleh tenaga profesional sesuai dengal profesi masing-masing berupa konseling, terapi dan advokasi guna penguatal dan pemulihan korban kekerasan.  
3-

7. Perlindungan adalah segala tindakan pelayanan untuk menjamin dan melindungi hak-hak korban tindak kekerasan yang diselenggarakan oleh Pusat Pelayanan Terpadu.  
8. Pencegahan adalah segala Tindakan atau usaha yang dilakukan untuk menghilangkan berbagai faktor yang menyebabkan terjadinya tindak kekerasan terhadap perempuan.  
9. Perempuan adalah manusia dewasa berjenis kelamin perempuan dan orang yang oleh hukum diakui sebagai perempuan.  
10. Kekerasaa adalah setiap perbuatan secara melawan hukum dengan atau tanpa menggunalan sarana terhadap frsik dan psikis yang menimbulkan bahaya bagi nyawa, badan atau menimbulkan terampasnya kemerdekaan seseorang.  
11. Kekerasan Terhadap Perempuan adalah setiap tindakan berdasarkan perbedaan jenis kelamin yang berakibat atau mungkin berakibat kesengsaraan atau penderitaan Perempuan secara fisik, seksual atau psikologis, termasuk Erncaman tindakan tertentu, pemalsaan atau perampasan kemerdekaan secara sewenang-wenang, baik yang terjadi di ranah publik atau dalam kehidupan pribadi.  
12. Korban adalah Perempuan yang mengalami tindak kekerasan.  
13. Rehabilitasi Kesehatan adalah pemulihan Korban perdagangan orang dari gangguan kesehatal yang dideritanya.  
14. Rehabilitasi Sosial adalah pelayanan yang ditujukan untuk memulihkan dan mengembangkan kemampuan seseorang yang mengalami disfungsi sosial agar dapat melaksanakan fungsi sosialnya secara wajar.  
15. Pemulangan adalah upaya pengembalian Perempuan Korban Kekerasan kepada piha-k Keluarga, keluarga pengganti, atau masyarakat yang dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pemenuhan kebutuhannya.  
16. Reintegrasi Sosial adalah upaya penyatuan kembali korban dengan pihak Keluarga, keluarga pengganti, atau masyarakat yang dapat memberikan perlindungan dan pemenuhan kebutuhan bagr Korban.  
17. Bantuan Hukum adalah jasa hukum yang diberikan oleh pendamping hukum dal advokat untuk melakukan proses pendampingan salsi dan/atau Korban Kekerasan terhadap Perempuan dan anak yang sensitif gender.  
18. Unit Pelaksana Teknis Daerah Perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak yang selanjutnya disingkat UPTD PPA adalah unit pelaksana teknis daerah yang dibentuk pemerintah daerah dalam memberikan layanan bagi perempuan dan anak yang mengalami kekerasan, diskriminasi, perlindungan khusus, dan masalah lainnya.  
19. Rumah Aman adalah tempat tinggal sementara, yang diberikan untuk memberikan perlindungal terhadap Korban sesuai dengan standar yang telah ditentukan.  
4-

#### Pasal 2

Perlindungan Perempuan Korban Perempuan betujuan untuk: a. melindungi Perempuan Korban Kekerasan;  
b. memberikan Pelayanan kepada Perempuan Korban tindak Kekerasan; dan c. pemberdayaan Perempuan Korban Kekerasan;  
d. peningkatan kapasitas Perempuan korban kekerasan dalam pemberdayaan perempuan melalui Organisasi Perargkat Daerah terkait, Pihak Swasta, Dunia Usaha dan lain-lain.

# BAB II

## HAK KORBAN

#### Pasal 3

Korban berhak mendapatkan:
a. Perlindungan dari pihak:
1. Keluarga;  
2. kepolisian;  
3. kejaksaaa;  
4. pengadilan;  
5. advokat; dan
6. lembaga sosial, atau pihak lainnya baik sementara maupun berdasarkan penetapan perintah Perlindungan dari pengadilan.  b. Pelayanan kesehatan sesuai dengan kebutuhan medis;  
c. penanganan secara khusus berkaitan dengan kerahasiaan Korban; d. pendampingan oleh pekerja sosial dan Bantuan Hukum pada setiap tingkat proses pemeriksaan sesuai dengan ketentuan peraturan perundang unda-rlgan;  
e. Pelayanan bimbingan rohani; dartf. Korban memiliki hak menentukan sendiri keputusannya terkait pilihal mana yang akan dilaksanakan.

# BAB III

## KEWENANGAN DAN TANGGUNG JAWAB

#### Pasal 4

1. Pemerintah Daerah berwenang dan bertanggung jawab atas Perlindungan Perempuan Korban Kekerasan.  
2. Kewenangan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi: a. kegiatan Pelayanan terhadap Perempuan Korban Kekerasan; b. pemantauan, penguatan terhadap korban Kekerasan; danc. peningkatan kemarnpual aparatur dan para pemangku kepentingan lain.

# BAB IV

## KELEMBAGAAN

#### Pasal 5

1. Bupati membentuk UPTD PPA.  
2. Ketentuan lebih lanjut mengenai tata cara pembentukan UPTD PPA sebagairnala dimaksud pada ayat (1) diatur dengan Peraturan Bupati.

# REGENT OF PENAJAM PASER UTARA

# EAST KALIMANTAN PROVINCE

REGIONAL REGULATION OF PENAJAM PASER UTARA REGENCY NUMBER 1 OF 2023

# CONCERNING

PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE BY THE GRACE OF GOD ALMIGHTY

# REGENT OF PENAJAM PASER UTARA,

Considering that acts of violence against women constitute
a. violations of human rights and therefore their dignity and honor need to be protected and their right to life guaranteed in accordance with their nature without discrimination;  

that to prevent and address violence
b. against women, legal protection needs to be provided for women victims of violence;  

that Penajam Paser Utara Regency does not yet have
c. a regulatory basis regarding the implementation of protection for women victims of violence;  

that based on the considerations as referred to
d. in letter a, letter b, and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation on the Protection of Women Victims of Violence;

#### Article 18 Paragraph (6) of the 1945 Constitution of the Republic

1. of Indonesia;  

Law Number 7 of 2002 concerning the Establishment of Penajam Paser Utara Regency in East Kalimantan Province (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2001 Number 20, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 4182);  

Law Number 23 of 2004 concerning

3. the Elimination of Domestic Violence (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2004 Number 95); Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning
4. Regional Government (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2014 Number 244, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 5587) as amended several times most recently by Law Number 11 of 2020 concerning Job Creation (State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia of 2020 Number 245, Supplement to the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia Number 6573);  
5. Regulation of the Minister of Women's Empowerment and Child Protection Number 4 of 2018 concerning Guidelines for the Establishment of Regional Technical Implementation Units for the Protection of Women and Children (State News of the Republic of Indonesia of 2018 Number 532);  

With the Mutual Approval of THE REGIONAL HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES OF PENAJAM PASER UTARA REGENCY and

##### THE REGENT OF PENAJAM PASER UTARA

##### DECIDES:

To Establish A REGIONAL REGULATION CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE.

# CHAPTER I

## GENERAL PROVISIONS

#### Article 1

In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Region is Penajam Paser Utara Regency.  
2. Regional Government is the Regent as an element of the regional government administration who leads the implementation of governmental affairs that are the authority of the autonomous region of Penajam Paser Utara Regency.  
3. Regent is the Regent of Penajam Paser Utara.  
4. Village is a legal community unit that has territorial boundaries authorized to regulate and manage governmental affairs, the interests of the local community based on community initiative, rights of origin and/or traditional rights that are recognized and respected in the governmental system of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia.  
5. Family is a person who has a blood relationship in a straight line upward or downward and in a collateral line up to the third degree, or who has a marital relationship, or a person who is the dependent of a woman.  
6. Service is an immediate activity and action carried out by professional personnel in accordance with their respective professions in the form of counseling, therapy and advocacy for the strengthening and recovery of victims of violence.  
7. Protection is all service actions to guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence organized by the Integrated Service Center.  
8. Prevention is any action or effort undertaken to eliminate various factors that cause acts of violence against women.  
9. Woman is an adult human of female sex and a person recognized by law as a woman.  
10. Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against the physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom.  
11. Violence Against Women is any act based on gender difference that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for Women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life.  
12. Victim is a Woman who experiences acts of violence.  
13. Health Rehabilitation is the recovery of Victims of trafficking in persons from health disorders they suffer.  
14. Social Rehabilitation is a service aimed at restoring and developing the ability of a person experiencing social dysfunction to be able to carry out social functions normally.  
15. Repatriation is an effort to return Women Victims of Violence to the Family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of their needs.  
16. Social Reintegration is an effort to reunite victims with the Family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for Victims.  
17. Legal Aid is legal services provided by legal assistants and advocates to carry out the process of accompanying sanctions and/or Victims of Violence against Women and children that are gender sensitive.  
18. Regional Technical Implementation Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a regional technical implementation unit established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection, and other problems.  
19. Safe House is a temporary residence, provided to give protection to Victims in accordance with predetermined standards.  

#### Article 2

The Protection of Women Victims of Women aims to: a. protect Women Victims of Violence;  
b. provide Services to Women Victims of acts of Violence; and c. empower Women Victims of Violence;  
d. increase the capacity of women victims of violence in women's empowerment through related Regional Apparatus Organizations, Private Parties, Business World and others.

# CHAPTER II

## RIGHTS OF VICTIMS

#### Article 3

Victims have the right to receive:
a. Protection from:
1. Family;  
2. police;  
3. prosecutor's office;  
4. court;  
5. advocate; and
6. social institutions, or other parties either temporarily or based on the determination of a Protection order from the court.  b. health services in accordance with medical needs;  
c. special handling related to the confidentiality of Victims; d. assistance by social workers and Legal Aid at every level of the examination process in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations;  
e. spiritual guidance Services; andf. Victims have the right to determine their own decisions regarding which options will be implemented.

# CHAPTER III

## AUTHORITY AND RESPONSIBILITY

#### Article 4

1. The Regional Government has the authority and responsibility for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence.  
2. The authority as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. Service activities for Women Victims of Violence; b. monitoring, strengthening of victims of Violence; andc. capacity building of apparatus and other stakeholders.

# CHAPTER IV

## INSTITUTIONAL ARRANGEMENTS

#### Article 5

1. The Regent establishes UPTD PPA.  
2. Further provisions regarding the procedures for establishing UPTD PPA as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

#### Article 9

(1) The Regional Government is obliged to organize Prevention of Violence against Women quickly, in an integrated and integrated manner.  

2. The organization of Prevention of acts of Violence against Women as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out through the fields of:a. Education;  
b. Public Facilities and infrastructure;  
c. Government and institutional governanced. Economy and employment;  
e. Social welfare;  
f. Culture;  
g. Information technology;  
h. Religion; andi. Family

#### Article 10

Handling of women victims of violence is by providing integrated and unified services including:
a. coverage of Women Victims of Violence who receive complaint handling by trained officers in integrated Service units; b. coverage of Women Victims of Violence who receive health services by trained health workers at community health centers and hospitals: c. coverage of Social Rehabilitation services provided by trained Social Rehabilitation officers for Women Victims of Violence in integrated Service units:d. coverage of spiritual guidance services provided by trained spiritual guidance officers for Women Victims of Violence in integrated Service units:e. coverage of law enforcement from the investigation level to court decisions on cases of Violence Against Women; f. coverage of Women Victims of Violence who receive Legal Aid services;  
g. coverage of Repatriation services for Women Victims of Violence; and h. coverage of Social Reintegration services for Women Victims of Violence.  
7-

# CHAPTER VI

## SOCIAL PROTECTION HOUSE

#### Article 1 1

1. The Regional Government is obliged to establish a social protection house and/or Safe House or other designation.  
2. The social protection house and/or Safe House as referred to in paragraph (i) guarantees the implementation of Health Rehabilitation Services, Social Rehabilitation, Repatriation, and Social Reintegration.  
3. For the implementation of Services as referred to in paragraph (21, the Regional Government may utilize social Protection houses and/or Safe Houses owned by the community or other social Service institutions.

# CHAPTER VII

## MONITORING AND EVALUATION

#### Article 12

1. The Regional Government conducts monitoring to ensure synergy, continuity, and effectiveness of integrated steps in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence.  
2. Monitoring as referred to in paragraph (1) is to determine the progress and obstacles in the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence in the Region.

#### Article 13

1. Monitoring is carried out through coordination and direct monitoring of related Regional apparatus periodically.  
2. Monitoring is carried out from planning to implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women Victims of Violence for the current year.

#### Article 14

1. Evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs and activities for the Protection of Women is carried out at the end of each fiscal year or if required according to needs.  

(2) The results of the evaluation of the implementation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women are used as input material for the formulation of policies, programs, and activities for the Protection of Women for the following year.  

3. Evaluation as referred to in paragraph (1) is implemented in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.  
8-

# CHAPTER VIII

## REPORTING

#### Article 15

1. The Regent is responsible for making reports on the implementation of SPM in the field of integrated services for Women Victims of Violence and submitted to the Governor with a copy submitted to the State Minister for Women's Empowerment and Child Protection and the Minister of Home Affairs.  
2. Reporting of implementation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out annually.  
3. Further provisions regarding the procedures and form of reporting as referred to in paragraph (1) shall be regulated by Regent Regulation.

# CHAPTER IX

## GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION

#### Article 16

1. The Regent conducts guidance on the development of UPTD PPA. (2) Guidance as referred to in paragraph (1) includes: a. provision of implementation instructions;  
b. guidance;  
c. supervision; andd. monitoring and evaluation of the implementation of Services for Women Victims of Violence, both apparatus and community.

#### Article 17

The Regent conducts guidance and supervision over the implementation of SPM in the field of integrated services for Women Victims of Violence in the Region.

# CHAPTER X

## COMMUNITY PARTICIPATION

#### Article 18

1. In organizing Protection for Women Victims of Violence, the community may:a. form Family partners at the sub-district/Village level;  
b. form Women's Protection units within community organizations;  
c. conduct socialization of Women's rights independently;  
d. provide first aid to Victims; ande. report to the competent authority if Violence against Victims occurs in their environment.  

(21 Community participation as referred to in paragraph (1) is carried out by individuals, community social institutions, non-governmental organizations, educational institutions, religious institutions, the private sector, and mass media.  
9-

# CHAPTER XI

## FUNDING

#### Article 19

Funding in the implementation of Protection for Women Victims of Violence is sourced from:
a. Regional revenue and expenditure budget; andb. other legal and non-binding sources in accordance with the provisions of laws and regulations.

# CHAPTER XII

## CLOSING PROVISIONS

#### Article 20

This Regional Regulation comes into force on the date of promulgation.  

So that everyone may know of it, orders the promulgation of this Regional Regulation by placing it in the Regional Gazette of Penajam Paser Utara Regency.

##### CONCERNING

##### PROTECTION OF WOMEN VICTIMS OF VIOLENCE

##### I. GENERAL

Violence against Women is one form of act that violates human rights. As is known, the rights of Women have been guaranteed and regulated in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia and the Law on Human Rights. Therefore, the protection of Women's rights from violence should be respected, enforced and human dignity enhanced without discrimination, welfare and justice for Women.

Violence is any act unlawfully with or without the use of means against physical and psychological that causes danger to life, body or results in the deprivation of a person's freedom. Furthermore, Violence against women is any action based on gender differences that results in or may result in suffering or hardship for women physically, sexually or psychologically, including threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in the public sphere or in private life. Violence against children is any act against a child that results in suffering or hardship physically, mentally, sexually, psychologically, including neglect and maltreatment that threatens the integrity of the body and degrades the dignity of the child. The existence of Women victims of violence has not yet received adequate services so that minimum services are needed for victims of violence.

In order to prevent and overcome violence against Women in Penajam Paser Utara Regency so as to avoid violence, threats of violence, torture or treatment that degrades human dignity and worth, it is necessary to provide protection for Women victims of violence in the form of a Regional Regulation.

This Regional Regulation regulates protection efforts for Women victims of violence, particularly in terms of services, monitoring and evaluation, reporting, funding, guidance and supervision of Women victims of violence in Penajam Paser Utara Regency.
